page_title: Samsung DeX for Mac: DeX in a Mac Window — Deskbridge

sources.entry: Deskbridge - Menu bar app that opens a Samsung Galaxy phone's DeX desktop in a Mac window over USB or Wi-Fi, with phone apps in their own windows, call banners and notifications.

summary.name: Deskbridge
summary.one_liner: A paid macOS menu bar app that opens a Samsung Galaxy phone's Samsung DeX desktop in a Mac window over USB or Wi-Fi, with phone apps, calls and notifications on the Mac.
use_cases: Use a Samsung Galaxy phone's DeX desktop in a window on a Mac
Control phone apps with a Mac keyboard and trackpad
Mirror an Android phone screen to a Mac without a monitor or dock
Keep a phone screen dark while using its apps from a Mac
Answer phone or WhatsApp calls and see notifications on a Mac
Send files from Finder into WhatsApp or Messages on the phone
summary.what_it_does: Deskbridge connects a Samsung Galaxy (One UI 8 or later) to a Mac over USB or Wi-Fi and shows the phone's DeX desktop in a resizable Mac window, with a taskbar and apps that can be driven by the Mac's keyboard and trackpad. It can open individual phone apps in their own phone-sized windows and shows phone calls and notifications as Mac banners and Notification Center items. A Secure Blackout mode turns the phone screen black while DeX keeps running, and an unlock shortcut lets the user type the PIN from the Mac. The page says it is built on the open-source scrcpy tool, sends data directly between phone and Mac with no account or cloud, and offers a landscape or portrait layout and file drag-and-drop from Finder.
notable: Secure Blackout keeps the phone screen off while DeX runs on the Mac
Built on scrcpy; the page states it is not made by Samsung
Signed and notarized by Apple; no account or cloud; data goes directly between phone and Mac
caveats: Full DeX desktop requires a Samsung Galaxy on One UI 8 or later (verified on Galaxy Z Fold 7); other Android phones get screen mirroring only
Pixel desktop mode is in beta and needs Android 16 QPR3+
Free 7-day trial, then a one-time $12 purchase; optional Pro add-on is $5/year
Requires USB debugging to be enabled on the phone once; a locked phone hides the DeX dock and blocks typing until unlocked
